name: tinja
summary: CLI tool for testing web pages for template injection vulnerabilities.
highlights: --config — set the path for a config file to be read
--csti — enable scanning for Client-Side Template Injections using a headless browser
--escapereport — escape HTML special chars in the JSON report
--precedinglength — how many chars shall be memorized, when getting the preceding chars of a body reflection p
--proxycertpath — set the path for the certificate of the proxy
--proxyurl — set the URL of the proxy

subcommands.name: url
subcommands.description: Scan a single or multiple URLs

flags.name: --config
flags.description: set the path for a config file to be read

flags.name: --csti
flags.description: enable scanning for Client-Side Template Injections using a headless browser

flags.name: --escapereport
flags.description: escape HTML special chars in the JSON report

flags.name: --precedinglength
flags.description: how many chars shall be memorized, when getting the preceding chars of a body reflection point (default 30)

flags.name: --proxycertpath
flags.description: set the path for the certificate of the proxy

flags.name: --proxyurl
flags.description: set the URL of the proxy

flags.name: --ratelimit
flags.description: number of requests per seconds. 0 is infinite (default 0)

flags.name: --reportpath
flags.description: set the path for a report to be generated

flags.name: --subsequentlength
flags.description: how many chars shall be memorized, when getting the subsequent chars of a body reflection point (default 30)

flags.name: --useragentchrome
flags.description: set chrome as user-agent. Default user-agent is 'TInjA v1.2.0'

flags.name: --verbosity
flags.description: verbosity of the output. 0 = quiet, 1 = default, 2 = verbose (default 1)
